project_type: Python 3.11 credit-memo analysis monorepo (FastAPI/SQLAlchemy services under app/, offline CLI at app/cli.py). Business Overview (BO) module with a v3 four-module eight-primary agent roster; Module 3 is Corporate Structure & Senior Management.
build_system: uv-managed virtualenv already prepared at .worktrees/m3-standalone/.venv. No separate compile step (pure Python).
test_framework: pytest (unit + integration). Offline tests use ScriptedBoBackend (app/services/bo/offline.py, a FakeLLMBackend that calls no model) or recorded-proposal replay. conftest blocks live SEC and disables .env.
build_command: none (interpreted). Import-check a changed module with: DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -c "import app.services.bo.<module>"
test_command: DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -m pytest <paths> -q   (run with the worktree as cwd)
verification_instructions: 1) Run the targeted M3 suite after each change: DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_bo_m3_onboarding_transform.py tests/unit/test_bo_m3_corporate_structure.py tests/integration/test_bo_m3_v6_integration.py -q (baseline 55 passed). 2) Run new M3 test modules. 3) At the end run the FULL offline suite: DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q and compare to the baseline 1384 passed / 131 skipped / 12 errors. The 12 errors are the KNOWN pre-existing env issue: tests/integration/test_bo_recorded_completion.py depends on an UNTRACKED output dir output/bo/HCA_M3_REFINEMENT_LIVE_20261018_R5/ and are NOT regressions. Zero NEW failures/errors allowed; weaken NO existing expectation. Clean up temp files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Deterministic JSON artifacts are written with app.core.hashing.canonical_json for byte-stability (no timestamps/random ids). The demo dir (m3_corporate_structure.json, m3_analysis.json, m3_structure_provenance.json, validation_report.json, evaluation_scorecard.json, run_manifest.json) is produced by the CLI/demo helper, not committed. No checked-in generated snapshots for M3.
environment_constraints: Offline ONLY; no paid/live model calls (tests use ScriptedBoBackend or recorded replay). conftest blocks live SEC + disables .env. Always pass cwd=.worktrees/m3-standalone and use the worktree .venv python by absolute or relative path. Commit locally on feat/m3-standalone; never push. Do NOT read/echo secrets.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. Governing rules live in .kiro/steering/credit-memo-principles.md (always-on): evidence-first (never fabricate facts/figures/sources/citations), never hide uncertainty (VERIFIED/CALCULATED/ASSUMPTION/INFERRED/MISSING/CONFLICTING), separate deterministic calculation from AI judgement, keep humans in the loop, auditability/reproducibility, protect sensitive info. Preserve the single specialist m3_corporate_management, Validator 7 and its interfaces, the narrative contract, evidence-admission/provenance, missing-JSON safeguards and the credit-signal vocabulary. All schema changes additive/versioned/backward-compatible. No out-of-scope downstream work (Modules 1/2/4, synthesizer, challenger, synthesis-revision, final cross-module validation, memo renderer, HTML/PDF/DOCX, visualisation/onboarding UI, lending-recommendation engine). No new specialist agents or scoring/weighting frameworks; no hardcoded HCA structural data/coordinates/business conclusions.
key_patterns: CLI subcommands in app/cli.py use argparse subparsers + a _run_<cmd>(session, database, args) helper returning a dict printed as JSON; see run-bo-specialists -> _run_bo_specialists and the `python -m scripts.<x>` scripts (argparse + json.loads(Path.read_text) + print(json.dumps(...))) for entry-point conventions, and app/services/structural_overview/__main__.py for a `python -m` module main. Single-specialist execution pattern: app/services/bo/single_specialist.py::run_m1s2 uses comparison.prepare_specialist + run_single_pass with V3_SPEC_BY_CODE[...] and persists an AgenticAnalysisRun + EvidencePacketRow + AuditLog; mirror it with V3_SPEC_BY_CODE['M3']. The M3 corporate_structure_source is read by completion.build_m3_corporate_structure from the M3 agent call inputs; attach it via completion.admit_corporate_structure_source (records registered_case_id + case_id + content hash; never infers case from filename/name). Validator 7 governance: m3_validation.validate_m3_assessment downgrades conservatively, keeps credit_direction/verification/availability in SEPARATE fields, and embeds the original proposal for audit. Deterministic semantic checks: semantic_entailment.DeterministicCheck/SemanticEntailmentEvaluator (never overrides numeric/period/entity mismatches; fail-closed). Eval harnesses: m3_evaluation.evaluate_architecture and m3_semantic_eval.evaluate report EXPLICIT numerator/denominator and label actual LLM accuracy 'not_measured'. Strict pydantic models use model_config extra='forbid' (schemas/bo_m3.py, schemas/bo_m3_structure.py) so only ADD optional fields with defaults.
build_command_note: There is no compile step; 'build' = module imports cleanly and pytest collects.
